name: NoCodeDevs

sources.title: Site now brands as 'MakerThrive' — video-first SaaS distribution/partnership service

requirements: The former NoCodeDevs community/directory has rebranded to MakerThrive, a paid distribution service: dedicated YouTube breakdown + newsletter + social amplification
Target customer is a SaaS/tool maker wanting exposure to 'high-intent builders'; claims 10K+ YouTube subs, 13K+ newsletter readers, 56K+ X followers, ~40K avg views/video
No self-serve listing — everything runs through a booked partnership
preparation: Budget for a sponsored feature (pricing in the media kit, not captured)
A tactical angle: how your tool fits a builder workflow — they produce in-depth 'we build with it' breakdowns, not banner ads
Product access/demo materials for the production team
workflow: Review the media kit at nocodedevs.com/media-kit
Align on a tactical narrative/angle with their team
They produce a dedicated video breakdown
Distribution across YouTube, X and the newsletter; content stays evergreen
watchFor: The 'NoCodeDevs' directory/community listed in the catalog no longer exists as a submission destination — do not expect a free listing
This is an influencer-style paid feature, not a directory; deliverables are content, not a permanent listing entry
Pricing only via media kit/booking — nothing public
SaaS fit required; they decline to 'just read your landing page' — expect production lead time
countsAsLive: A published MakerThrive video breakdown and associated social/newsletter distribution featuring the product
unknowns: Whether any remnant of the old no-code tools directory accepts submissions
Whether web properties (vs video) still get any listing
Lead time from booking to publish
